scope: Continue the already observed durable process inventory snapshot using only each server-returned opaque next_cursor; no new process execution or process_start replay.
privacy: Keep all raw inventory pages privately; only publish exact target-related records and hashes/counts. No unrelated args or credentials read.
on_refused_cursor: Stop and preserve refusal. A fresh first snapshot can be requested as documented; never construct a cursor.
on_transport_error: Preserve original error and stop this call loop; no process resubmission.
